title: 两TB空闲不等于都能消耗
premise: 查询优化可降低I/O，但净数据增长仍占存储，需要明确预留空间。
listeningTask: 算清空闲、受保护预留和可用于增长的空间。

lines.en: Storage headroom is two terabytes physically. Six used, eight available, same decimal units.
lines.zh: 物理空闲两TB，已用六TB、可用八TB，都是十进制单位。

lines.en: How much of that is protected reserve? Temporary operations need space as well.
lines.zh: 其中多少是受保护预留？临时操作也需要空间。

lines.en: Twenty percent reserved, one-point-six terabytes today. That leaves four hundred gigabytes spendable.
lines.zh: 预留百分之二十，现在是一点六TB，可消耗空间剩四百GB。

lines.en: Just to confirm, about two months, right? At the measured net growth rate.
lines.zh: 确认一下，大约两个月，对吧？按测得的净增长率。

lines.en: Yes, before touching that protected reserve. Campaign growth could shorten it considerably.
lines.zh: 是，指触及受保护预留前，活动增长可能明显缩短时间。

lines.en: Our retention policy already informs growth forecast. We can't count unapproved deletion savings.
lines.zh: 保留规则已经计入预测，不能算未经批准的删除收益。

lines.en: Replica storage needs the same review. A bigger primary with undersized replicas fails.
lines.zh: 副本存储也要同样评审，主库变大而副本不足会失败。

lines.en: Okay, storage ordering is an action item. What's the ETA for delivery confirmation?
lines.zh: 好，申请存储是一个行动项，预计什么时候确认交付？

lines.en: Tomorrow for the supplier's delivery estimate. Actual provisioning may take three weeks.
lines.zh: 明天拿供应方交付估计，实际开通可能要三周。

lines.en: So, approve preparation without waiting for queries. Efficiency won't erase retained order growth.
lines.zh: 那批准准备，不必等查询优化，效率改善不会消除保留订单增长。
